reason: Conversation 2 correctly diagnosed a broken right-hand balance spring/cable from the twang and one-sided tension. It gave sensible safety advice (isolate power and water, do not rehook the tensioned spring, replace springs as a pair) and offered an engineer as an option when the customer could not pull the unit out. It did slightly overstate its confidence and gave a somewhat long DIY removal walkthrough that the customer had said they could not manage, but it still clearly served them better. Conversation 1 repeated generic 'door hinge' conclusions, ignored the loose spring the customer found, gave no safety guidance, and ended with a vague engineer suggestion, though it did correctly ask for the model number and did not claim an exact part.
